definitions.gloss: reservation system; appointment system; by reservation only
definitions.explanation: A system requiring advance booking or reservation before visiting or using a service.

examples.japanese: このレストランは{予約制|よやくせい}です。
examples.english: This restaurant is by reservation only.

examples.japanese: {予約制|よやくせい}なので、{事前|じぜん}に{電話|でんわ}してください。
examples.english: Since it's by reservation, please call in advance.

examples.japanese: {病院|びょういん}は{完全|かんぜん}{予約制|よやくせい}になった。
examples.english: The hospital has switched to a complete appointment system.

notes:
FORMATION:
{予約|よやく} (reservation) + {制|せい} (system)

VARIATIONS:
・{予約制|よやくせい} - reservation system
・{完全|かんぜん}{予約制|よやくせい} - completely by reservation only
・{一部|いちぶ}{予約制|よやくせい} - partially by reservation

COLLOCATIONS:
・{予約制|よやくせい}を{導入|どうにゅう}する - to implement a reservation system
・{予約制|よやくせい}になる - to become by reservation only
・{予約制|よやくせい}です - it's by reservation only

CONTRAST:
・{予約制|よやくせい} - by reservation
・{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん} - first-come, first-served
・{自由|じゆう}{席|せき} - open seating (no reservation)

CONTEXTS:
・{病院|びょういん} - hospitals/clinics
・レストラン - restaurants
・{美容院|びよういん} - beauty salons
・{美術館|びじゅつかん} - museums
